warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender P400 DC-DC Converter Failure
paragraphs: If your Defender P400 is a mild-hybrid model — which all P400s are — the DC-DC converter is a known single point of failure for the entire 12V electrical system. Failure can cause complete loss of electrical power, sometimes while driving. We replace the DC-DC converter as standard on every P400 rebuild, along with timing chains, bearings and gaskets.
The P300 Defender (non-MHEV petrol) is NOT affected by this issue, as it doesn't use the same mild-hybrid system.
warning.source: Source: verified via specialist buying guide (l663.guide), independently corroborated, per VRF-landrover-defender.md. P300 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF
